title: Half the photo price to charity
hook: Two stated cases: explore donations and sales costs in profit.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How donations and sales costs in profit affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Profit, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare donations and sales costs in profit in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
